'''Matt Allen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Brussels Grand Slam]] on 11 August 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] and strike team (Madine, Kensaric, Carlson, bunker), according to Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-european-continentalsd1133/ european-continentals], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-european-continentalsd1133/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
